targets.rawSql: WITH host_cat AS (  SELECT h.aid,         a.raw->>'cloud_provider'    AS cloud_provider,         a.raw->>'cloud_instance_id' AS instance_id,    CASE      WHEN a.raw->>'cloud_provider' = 'AWS' THEN 'AWS'      WHEN h.external_ip LIKE '92.207.176.2%'        AND (h.local_ip LIKE '10.20.7.%' OR h.local_ip LIKE '10.20.9.%'             OR h.local_ip LIKE '10.20.98.%' OR lower(h.hostname) LIKE 'lon%'             OR lower(h.hostname) LIKE 'meeting%' OR lower(h.hostname) LIKE 'cicd%')      THEN 'Office' ELSE 'Other' END AS category  FROM falcon.hosts h  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT az.raw FROM falcon.assets az WHERE az.aid = h.aid    ORDER BY (az.entity_type='managed') DESC, az.last_seen_ts DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) a ON TRUE), ov AS (  SELECT v.*, COALESCE(hc.category,'Unknown') AS category,         hc.instance_id, hc.cloud_provider,    CASE WHEN vr.remediation_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(vr.remediation_ids) = 0      THEN 'No fix available'      ELSE COALESCE(rem.titles, 'No fix available') END AS remediation,    (vr.remediation_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(vr.remediation_ids) = 0     OR COALESCE(rem.titles,'') ILIKE '%no fix%') AS no_fix  FROM falcon.v_open_vulns v  LEFT JOIN host_cat hc ON hc.aid = v.aid  LEFT JOIN falcon.vulns vr ON vr.vuln_id = v.vuln_id  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT r.title, '; ') AS titles    FROM falcon.remediations r WHERE r.remediation_id = ANY(vr.remediation_ids)) rem ON TRUE) SELECT count(*) AS v FROM ov WHERE severity IN (${severity:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(platform_name,'UNKNOWN') IN (${platform:singlequote}) AND category IN (${category:singlequote}) AND ('${host}' = '' OR hostname ILIKE '%${host}%' OR instance_id ILIKE '%${host}%') AND ('${kev}' = 'all' OR is_cisa_kev::text = '${kev}') AND ('${nofix}' = 'all' OR no_fix::text = '${nofix}')

') AS titles    FROM falcon.remediations r WHERE r.remediation_id = ANY(vr.remediation_ids)) rem ON TRUE) SELECT cve_id, severity, exprt_rating, cvss_base_score AS cvss, is_cisa_kev AS kev, category, hostname, instance_id, cloud_provider AS cloud, platform_name AS platform, product_name, no_fix, remediation, last_seen FROM ov WHERE severity IN (${severity:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(platform_name,'UNKNOWN') IN (${platform:singlequote}) AND category IN (${category:singlequote}) AND ('${host}' = '' OR hostname ILIKE '%${host}%' OR instance_id ILIKE '%${host}%') AND ('${kev}' = 'all' OR is_cisa_kev::text = '${kev}') AND ('${nofix}' = 'all' OR no_fix::text = '${nofix}') ORDER BY (severity='CRITICAL') DESC, cvss_base_score DESC NULLS LAST, last_seen DESC LIMIT 5000
